mapper.select: select distinct bp.id, bp.name, bp.image, bp.points, bp.description, bp.create_user, bp.create_time, bp.update_time, bp.update_user, bp.is_shelf, bp.month_limit, su.nickname as updateUserString, bp.type_id, su2.nickname as createUserString from biz_product bp left join sys_user su on bp.update_user = su.id left join sys_user su2 on bp.create_user = su2.id ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by bp.create_time desc
